newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Marlin to get control of Kudu.
newsitem.headline: Marlin to get control of Kudu.

text.p: South African holding firm Marlin Holdings Ltd said on Monday that it had agreed a deal which would see it acquire 58.8 percent of granite group Kudu Granite Ltd and shareholders claims against the acquired firm.
The firm released no further details of the terms of the deal in a brief statement.
It said shareholders should exercise caution while trading in Marlin and Kudu shares until further details are announced.
On Friday talks between Kelgran Ltd and Kudu failed when Kelgran's controlling shareholder Malaysian firm Mycom SA said it had terminated the negotiations.
Analysts had speculated another suitor was probably waiting in the wings.
Kudu is controlled by majority overseas shareholder Deutsche Steinindustrie.
